data.long_meaning: The name Emilina is derived from the Latin name Aemiliana. It is a combination of the names Emma and Lina. Emma means 'universal' or 'whole' in Germanic languages, and Lina means 'flexible' or 'soft' in Latin. In Christian tradition, the name Emilina represents the strength and flexibility of the Virgin Mary. The name Emilina carries the meaning “Emma + Lina” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Emilina usually hope their child will grow to embody emma + lina and live with faith, good character and purpose.
